info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Unit Direction Management API
info.description: The Business Unit Direction Management API enables organizations to effectively set and manage strategic directions for their business units. This API facilitates the creation, modification, and alignment of business unit objectives within the broader control framework. Companies can leverage this endpoint to ensure cohesive direction across business units, optimize resource allocation, and enhance performance monitoring. Typical consumers include business analysts and unit managers who seek to align their operations with corporate strategy.

post.summary: Create a new business unit direction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new direction for a specific business unit, enabling better control and management of strategic objectives.
